name: Islam Ragab Eid
role: Program Manager and Certified Trainer · Entrepreneurship, Innovation and Youth Development
aka: Also known on social media as Islam Hagg Salem
intro: A specialist in designing and managing entrepreneurship and training programs and in building partnerships with government, international and civil-society institutions. His work combines field project management, training, mentoring and digital systems, and it is measured by results.
motto: Understand the need. Plan with rigor. Deliver in the field. Measure the impact.

titles.digital: Digital systems and the status of each
titles.field: From the field: the vaccination campaign

expertise.title: Program design and management
expertise.body: Planning programs, schedules and budgets; managing teams and volunteers; monitoring, evaluation and reporting.

expertise.title: Entrepreneurship and incubation
expertise.body: Scouting, assessing and selecting startups; mentoring on business models; running competitions and connecting founders with support organizations.

expertise.title: Training and capacity building
expertise.body: Training youth, volunteers and university students in employability, entrepreneurship, digital skills and AI.

expertise.title: Partnerships and resource development
expertise.body: Building partnerships with government, companies, universities and NGOs, and negotiating financial and in-kind support.

expertise.title: Digital systems
expertise.body: Designing volunteer, booking and registration systems on Google and no-code tools, and applying AI to training content and program management.

journey.title: Certified Trainer and Volunteer-System Contributor, Misr El Kheir Foundation
journey.body: Delivers training for youth and volunteers in entrepreneurship, digital skills and AI, takes part in training camps, and contributes to digital tools for registering, selecting and following up volunteers. About 100 volunteers trained.

journey.title: Media Coordinator, Netsharek Program, Ministry of Youth and Sports with UNICEF
journey.body: Handled documentation and media communication for the program’s youth activities and initiatives in Fayoum.

journey.title: Administrative Coordinator, Digital Egypt Cubs Initiative, Ministry of Communications and IT
journey.body: Handled administrative and operational coordination, participant records, and follow-up of schedules and activities.

journey.title: Entrepreneurship Activities Coordinator, Athar Business Accelerator, Digital Egypt Innovation Hub, Fayoum
journey.body: Coordinated entrepreneurship, innovation and training activities, took part in scouting, assessing and selecting startups, negotiated with sponsors and partners, and built partnerships with government entities, companies and institutions to widen training and employment opportunities. Acted as project lead for three months.

journey.title: Project Development Team Member, Ahl Masr Foundation
journey.body: Contributed to planning, follow-up and reporting for community projects.

journey.title: RCCE Project Manager, Egyptian Red Crescent, Fayoum
journey.body: Managed field delivery of the USAID-funded project with the Ministry of Health, supervising about 124 volunteers and a 10-person medical team, handled finance and logistics, produced technical, financial and statistical reports, and introduced a weekly reporting system that did not exist before.

journey.title: Volunteer, relief and emergency leadership
journey.body: Deputy Youth and Volunteering Officer, Relief and Emergency Team Leader, Emergency Team member, and leader of the volunteer psychological support team.

journey.title: Trainer and mentor in entrepreneurship and employability
journey.body: Certified trainer for the Ministry of Higher Education (Be Prepared initiative) for university students, entrepreneurship trainer in the BRICS Simulation Program of the Ministry of Youth and Sports, mentor in the Creativity Ambassadors Program of the Ministry of Communications, Psychological First Aid trainer for three volunteer groups in Fayoum, and employability trainer with the International Organization for Migration.

field.body: He proposed moving from a fixed point to daily village visits and persuaded management and the team. Daily vaccinations rose from a range of 2 to 9 people to a range of 45 to 90, and passed 120 on some days, and the team worked every day of the week.
field.note: Daily vaccinated range on one shared scale from 0 to 120, not a total. The figures are Islam’s own account; there was no formal target to compare against.
field.title: From a fixed vaccination point to daily village visits

programs.title: Preparing youth and graduates for work to safety standards
programs.body: Designed, managed and delivered in Fayoum with an energy company and a first-aid organization, reaching 300 young women and men, combining employability skills, soft skills and occupational safety training.

programs.title: Volunteer qualification
programs.body: A program for the volunteers of a charitable foundation in Fayoum on presentation and public speaking, CV writing and building a professional LinkedIn profile.

programs.title: Preparing social-work students for the job market
programs.body: Training for fourth-year students on job search, advertised versus hidden jobs, building a professional network and personal finance basics for a career.

programs.title: Entrepreneurship and design thinking
programs.body: Took part in delivering the entrepreneurship program of the Creativity Ambassadors initiative in Fayoum and Sohag, and in preparing the entrepreneurship track of the BRICS simulation in Sharm El Sheikh.

programs.title: Civil-society organization management
programs.body: A training lecture in Cairo for civil-society leaders and coordinators from South Sudan living in Egypt, covering strategic planning, managing teams and volunteers, resource sustainability and governance.

honors.title: Honored by Mrs. Intissar El-Sisi
honors.body: Honored as the representative of the Egyptian Red Crescent Fayoum branch.

honors.title: Honored by businessman Ahmed Abou Hashima
honors.body: Honored in the Startup Power competition after ECO Furniture won.

honors.title: Best Green Startup in Upper Egypt

ventures.title: Sportixa: an app for managing sports academies and facilities
ventures.body: Founder. A mobile application that is live and has customers, providing digital solutions for managing and operating sports academies and facilities, aimed at the Egyptian and Arab markets.

ventures.title: ECO Furniture: eco-friendly furniture from reused metal drums
ventures.body: Founder. Named Best Green Startup in Upper Egypt in 2022, ran a training initiative for about 50 technical-education students, 13 of whom took part-time jobs, and achieved an investment exit.

ventures.title: TamkeeNova HUB
ventures.body: A Fayoum training company that prepares Upper Egypt youth for the job market and builds partnerships to support training programs.

digital.title: Volunteer management: Red Crescent Fayoum and Misr El Kheir
digital.body: An online system covering registration, qualification, training and operations, implemented with both organizations.

digital.title: A version for Al-Nasser association
digital.body: A version is being prepared for the association, which is itself under formation.

digital.title: El Garhy Foundation for Development
digital.body: The system was presented to the foundation as a demonstration.

digital.title: Ramadan booking system for Misr El Kheir
digital.body: A booking system on Google tools, published with Ramadan 2027 dates.
